notes: Account snapshot: Thornfield Capital — multi-vertical research & client insights team. Heavy legacy docs (PDFs, research memos), proprietary datasets, regulatory filings.
Primary ask: replace legacy keyword search with RAG-style portal: embeddings + dense retrieval + small cross-encoder rerank. Focus on recall + precision for research analysts.
Index scale: plan currently ~120M documents (mix of short memos + long reports) -> estimated vectors ~120M, average tokens per doc variable (~1k), aggregate corpus ~20B tokens.
Latency targets: interactive research UX: P50 <100ms, P95 <180ms, P99 <250ms for top-k retrieval + rerank. EW latency budget for reranker is ~100-150ms.
Throughput/QPS: steady-state ~25 qps, peak ~70-90 qps during market events. Need predictable SLA under bursts.
Cost sensitivity: procurement wants <$0.01 per full query (retrieve+embed+rerank) at scale; if above, must justify via analyst efficiency gains.

Model preferences: open/hosted embedding models OK for PoC but production must run on dedicated infra. Interested in 1536-d embeddings or comparable; experimenting with quantized 1024-d to reduce index size.
Reranking: plan to run lightweight cross-encoder on top-50 candidates; prefer to keep reranker on dedicated GPUs (low-latency), fallback to smaller on-CPU model if capacity constrained.
Security: "will not accept hosted multi-tenant for production" — must support VPC deployment + customer-managed KMS. Audit logs retained 7+ years per compliance team.
Data residency: EU and US splits required for different funds; must be able to pin datasets and model serving to region. Customer prefers private control plane or private deployment option.

POC scope (30 days): ingest 5M representative docs, run search quality eval (recall@10, MRR), measure end-to-end latency, cost per query, resilience under synthetic bursts. Success criteria: +20% analyst task speedup in pick tests, P95 <200ms.
Quote from Head of Research: "We need deterministic latency and an auditable pipeline — if it can't meet residency+KMS, we can't move forward."

Technical notes: ingest pipeline uses S3 -> parquet -> vectorizer (Kubeflow). Network peering required for S3 + VPC endpoints. They asked about KV cache reuse and prefix caching to reduce token compute for long docs.
Integration asks: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, SCIM groups mapped to internal entitlements, audit hooks into SIEM (Splunk). Also data retention policy enforcement on deletion requests.

Operational preference: Dedicated capacity for production; would consider Hosted for sandbox with strict encryption in transit and at rest. Wants rollout canary policy and automatic fallback to smaller model family on overloads.
Known risks: security review delay; procurement wants fixed-cost element for forecasting; internal dependency on infra team for peering and KMS HSM certs.
POC deliverables: performance report, cost model (per-query), security checklist signed by Redwood, sample dashboard of query latencies and recall metrics.
Next meeting: onsite security review week of 2026-03-22 (tentative) — need DSLA draft + dedicated capacity pricing before moving to procurement.
